title: Medical Staff Scope Table for Virtual Care Encounters
content:
Five scope settings apply to each Virtual Care visit type: whether controlled substances may be prescribed, prescriptions renewed, labs ordered and referrals ordered from the encounter, and whether a work or school note may be issued from it.

## Definitions

- **Controlled prescribing** — whether controlled substances may be prescribed from the encounter.
- **Prescription renewal** — whether prescriptions may be renewed from the encounter.
- **Lab orders** — whether labs may be ordered from the encounter.
- **Referral orders** — whether a referral may be ordered from the encounter.
- **Work or school note** — whether a work or school note may be issued from the encounter.

## Scope by visit type

| Visit type | Controlled prescribing | Prescription renewal | Lab orders | Referral orders | Work or school note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Portal E-Visit | No | Yes | Yes | No | Yes |
| Audio-Only Phone Visit | No | Yes | No | No | Yes |
| Primary Care Video Visit | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Behavioral Health Video Visit | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | No |
| Specialty Video Follow-Up | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care | No | No | Yes | No | Yes |

## Reading the table by column

- **Controlled prescribing** is Yes on the Behavioral Health Video Visit only.
- **Prescription renewal** is Yes on every visit type except On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care.
- **Lab orders** are No on the Audio-Only Phone Visit and the Behavioral Health Video Visit, and Yes on the other four.
- **Referral orders** are Yes on the Primary Care Video Visit, the Behavioral Health Video Visit and the Specialty Video Follow-Up, and No on the Portal E-Visit, the Audio-Only Phone Visit and On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care.
- **Work or school notes** are No on the Behavioral Health Video Visit only.
